classification.description: ARTIFACT_DEFICIENT: the findings were real and unresolved — the work needs more attention. SPECIFICATION_DEFICIENT: the pass criteria were vague, contradictory, or unreachable, so no artifact could have passed. PROCESS_FAILURE: the two parties failed to converge on something they could have resolved — talking past each other, reopening settled points, drifting scope, or a reviewer escalating preferences past the stated threshold. INTEGRITY_BREACH: the record and the reviewer's memory disagreed.

evidence.description: Each claim tied to a specific round and quoted text. A conclusion nobody can trace back to the transcript is not usable here.

recommendation.description: What should happen next, concretely: what to change about the artifact, the criteria, or how the review was framed.
